machine_end_gcode:
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 E-1.2 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F1800 ;Retract and raise Z
{if max_layer_z < 50}
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 25} F900 ;Raise Z more
{endif}

G1 X2 Y218 F3000 ;Present print
M106 S0 ;Turn off part cooling fan
M104 S0 ;Turn off hotend
M140 S0 ;Turn off bed
M84 ;Disable steppers and clear homing state
machine_start_gcode:
M220 S100 ;Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ;Reset Flowrate

M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;Set bed temperature
G28 X Y ;Home X/Y
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;Wait for bed temperature
G28 Z ;Home Z using Fre3nder safe_z_home
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ;Generate a fresh mesh

M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Set nozzle temperature
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 X-2.0 Y20 Z0.3 F5000.0 ;Move to purge position
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Wait for nozzle temperature
G1 Z0.2 ;Lower nozzle to printing height
G1 Y145.0 F1500.0 E15 ;Draw first purge line
G1 X-1.7 F5000.0 ;Move sideways
G1 Y30 F1500.0 E15 ;Draw second purge line
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
name: Fre3nder Ender-3 V3 KE 0.4 nozzle
